in_sanskrit.name: Vm
in_sanskrit.meaning: हिन्दू नाम जिसका अर्थ है God
in_sanskrit.long_meaning: Vm एक संस्कृत नाम है जो हिंदू संस्कृति में गहरा आध्यात्मिक महत्व रखता है। Vasu means 'dwelling' or 'God'. It is also the name of a group of deities known as Vasus.

in_hindi.long_meaning: Vm एक हिंदू नाम है जो भारतीय संस्कृति में गहरा आध्यात्मिक महत्व रखता है। Vasu means 'dwelling' or 'God'. It is also the name of a group of deities known as Vasus.

in_tamil.name: Vm
in_tamil.long_meaning: Vm ஒரு இந்து பெயர் ஆகும், இது இந்திய கலாச்சாரத்தில் ஆழமான ஆன்மீக முக்கியத்துவத்தைக் கொண்டுள்ளது। Vasu means 'dwelling' or 'God'. It is also the name of a group of deities known as Vasus.

in_telugu.long_meaning: Vm ఒక హిందూ పేరు, ఇది భారతీయ సంస్కృతిలో లోతైన ఆధ్యాత్మిక ప్రాముఖ్యతను కలిగి ఉంది। Vasu means 'dwelling' or 'God'. It is also the name of a group of deities known as Vasus.
